provenance.asset_description: two separate illustrations overlayed over a blurred background. In the top left corner is an Order of the Eclipse Hellknight, artist Tom Ventre: A Hellknight from the Order of the Eclipse dressed head to toe in futuristic black plate armor clutches a two-handed rifle. Their face is covered by their horned helmet, and grenades and ammunition hang from a belt on their hip. In the bottom right corner is Vali Cairne, artist Josef Kucera: Vali Cairne stands confidently in her furred boots and colorful riding coat. Her hair is short and there are bird motifs on her coat.
